discrete_version.note: simulator applies a validated flow-rate and valve command for each mode

hybrid_version.note: preferred if hardware can modulate pump/valve continuously -- this project's pump range (0.010-0.050 kg/s) is continuous, so the hybrid version is RECOMMENDED

action_space.hard_rule: the controller must never command a flow or temperature outside this regime's flow_envelope_kg_s / max_safe_water_temp_C / max_safe_pcm_temp_C -- the safety shield below overrides the policy if it tries

reset_scenarios.name: partially_charged
reset_scenarios.note: PCM initialized at Tm_C (roughly 50% notional charge state)

reset_scenarios.name: fully_liquid
reset_scenarios.note: stresses discharge-heavy policies from a fully-charged start

acceptance_test_before_drl_training: every action stays within flow_envelope_kg_s / temperature limits above
the environment conserves energy (reuse Phase 4 Gate 1's <0.1% residual check)
the safety shield cannot be bypassed by the policy
the same seed reproduces the same trajectory
simulator output matches this Objective 2 re-evaluation for identical actions

dynamic_state_schema.description: One observation per control timestep. Fields marked measurable=false need an estimator (energy-balance + calibrated melt-fraction observer), not a raw sensor.

fields.name: f_melt_t
fields.source: estimator, derived from T_pcm_t via the frozen enthalpy model

fields.name: D_t
fields.source: flow meter at the draw-off point

fields.name: dp_t
fields.source: differential pressure sensor or Ergun estimate from mdot_t

fields.name: E_unmet_t
fields.source: estimator, from T_out_t vs delivery target

fields.name: T_water_top_C
fields.source: sensor at the tank outlet - this is the DELIVERY temperature

fields.name: T_water_bottom_C
fields.source: sensor at the collector return - this is the collector INLET

fields.name: recoverable_energy_above_45C_kWh
fields.source: estimator (WP1 E_rec,45), not a raw sensor

dynamic_state_schema.stratification_note: The tank is stratified and multi-node. Delivery temperature is the TOP node; the collector inlet is the BOTTOM node. Loop flow sets stratification, not collector heat.
